Il presente ci sfida e mette ognuno di noi alla prova. È un’occasione per dimostrare il nostro valore.

#AstanaInternationalForum
text: La interdependenza dei nostri destini è un fatto. Anche quando siamo chiamati a difendere la nostra sicurezza, la sicurezza dei nostri cittadini, la sicurezza dei nostri persone, dobbiamo continuare a unire i nostri esforzi anche a combattere il terrorismo, disminare le organizzazioni transnationali che profite da droga, armamenti e traffico. So, dear friends, everything around us seems to be changing and the few certainties we thought we had are no longer there. In this shifting epoch, the homogeneous blocks of the past no longer exist and relations between nations are based on new and very often unprecedented patterns. Present times are challenging us, testing each of us. But it is an occasion. It is an occasion of showing our value and it is up to us to decide how to act. We can take refugee in the now faded certainties of the past or we can try to look beyond or we can try to look beyond showing the courage that our peoples expect from us. I have no doubt and I know that I'm not alone along this path. Thank you very much.
